question: How is the six-limb procedure for this mantra prescribed?
premises: The procedure involves elements preceded by seed-syllables
It also involves six long elements
inference: The six-limb procedure is stated to use seed-syllable-preceded elements and six long ones.
uncertainties: The precise technical application of ṣaṭ+dīrghaiḥ is not fully specified
plain_english: The six-limb procedure is stated to be performed with elements preceded by seed-syllables and with six long ones.
